vectors.name: defaultApplyEvents - State Patching > should apply state delta patch correctly
vectors.spec: /spec/1.0/events/state#state_delta: STATE_DELTA amends the current state (at run start, the input's state) with an RFC 6902 patch
vectors.notes: Wrapped: the TS test feeds a bare STATE_DELTA; RUN_STARTED is prepended and RUN_FINISHED appended. The initial state is the RunAgentInput state the reducer starts from.
